beats.text: In Lanka, Ravana's younger brother Vibhishana begged him: 'Return Sita and end this war. Bad omens are everywhere.'
The ministers laughed. Indrajit called him a coward.
Ravana kicked him out of the court in a rage. 'You are an enemy dressed as a brother.'
Vibhishana flew across the sea with four loyal ministers to Rama's camp and asked for refuge.
Many advisors warned it was a trick. 'He is Ravana's brother,' Sugriva said. 'Do not trust him.'
Only Hanuman spoke for him. 'I have seen his heart. He is good.'
But Rama said, 'I never turn away someone who seeks shelter. Even if Ravana himself came to me, I would protect him.'
He crowned Vibhishana king of Lanka that day, with water from the sea.
